fact: The study, published in 2025, states that currently over 4,000 primary health care institutions (district hospitals, health centres and health posts), 95% of eligible health institutions in Ethiopia, are implementing both offline and web-based versions of DHIS2; of 208 facilities it visited, five did not use DHIS2.
title: Contributions of District Health Information Software 2 (DHIS2) to maternal and child health service performance in Ethiopia: an interrupted time series mixed-methods study
